This guide shows you what to do when: You get fired (your employer is not happy with you) You get laid off (your employer has no work for you) You quit (you choose to leave) You change jobs This guide is only for employees, not freelancers.

title: Calculate your notice period
text: Your job has a notice period ( Kündigungsfrist). It’s written in your work contract. If you quit, you must work until the end of your notice period. The notice period starts when your employer gets your resignation letter. Your notice period can be very long: 3 months is normal for some jobs. Some jobs have a 6-month notice period. To leave sooner, negotiate a shorter notice period with your employer. How the notice period works

title: Give your resignation letter
text: To quit your job, you must give a resignation letter ( Kündigungsschreiben). Your resignation is only valid when your employer receives your resignation letter. That’s when your notice period starts. How to write and send your resignation letter Your employer can’t force you to resign. Never write a resignation letter if you did not choose to resign.

title: See a doctor
text: If you quit for mental health reasons (burnout, depression, stress), get a sick note from a doctor. This proves that you had a valid reason to quit. If you don’t have a sick note, this is harder to prove. If you quit without a reason, you lose 3 months of unemployment benefits.

section: If you get fired or laid off
text: If your employer does not need you, you can get laid off. If your employer has financial problems, they can also put you on Kurzarbeit. If your employer is not happy with your work, you can get fired. You can’t get fired without a good reason, except during probation period. You get written warnings before you get fired, except for very serious reasons. [§ 626 BGB]

section: If you get fired or laid off
title: Resist
text: During your probation period, you can be fired without a reason. After your probation period ends, your employer needs a valid reason to fire you. If you don’t agree with the reason, you have 3 weeks to resist with a Kündigungsschutzklage. [§ 4 KSchG] These are often successful. Get legal help for this.

section: If you get fired or laid off
title: Finish your notice period
text: Your job has a notice period ( Kündigungsfrist), even during your probation period. If you get laid off, you get paid until the end of the notice period. During your notice period, your employer can make you work, or send you on garden leave. If you have unused vacation days, your employer usually forces you to go on vacation. If you get fired for misconduct, there might be no notice period. How the notice period works

section: If you get fired or laid off
title: Negotiate severance pay
text: If you get laid off, ask for severance pay ( Abfindung). Usually, you must sign a termination agreement ( Abwicklungsvertrag) to get severance pay. In other words, your employer pays you to leave without suing them. There is no guaranteed severance pay. You must negotiate how much severance pay you get. You usually get 0.5× your gross monthly income for each year of employment. [§ 1a KSchG, “It’s a guideline, not a legal entitlement” ( Andreas Martin, July 2025)] For example, if you work 5 years for an employer, your severance pay could be 2.5 months of income. A labour lawyer can help you negotiate better severance pay, because they know how much money you can get. Find a labour lawyer Severance pay can affect your unemployment benefits. If your severance pay is really high, you can lose 3 months of unemployment benefits. Sometimes, it’s better to refuse severance pay and get unemployment benefits. If you are not sure, ask a labour lawyer. How unemployment benefits work If you are over 50 years old and plan to retire soon, you can ask for pension payments instead of severance pay. It might be a better deal for you.

section: If you get fired or laid off
title: Do not sign an Auf­he­bungs­ver­trag
text: Your employer can suggest a termination agreement ( Aufhebungsvertrag). If you sign it, you don’t get fired; you agree to leave. This is not always a good idea. If you sign a termination agreement… You lose dismissal protection ( Kündigungsschutz) You can’t sue your employer for firing you, because you agreed to leave. Your employer wants you to sign an Aufhebungsvertrag because it’s safer for them. You can negotiate better severance pay ( Abfindung) Usually, severance pay depends on signing an Aufhebungsvertrag. This is the biggest benefit for you. You don’t always need an Aufhebungsvertrag. You might get more severance pay if you wait to get fired, then sue your employer. There is no minimum notice period You can agree to leave sooner. This is good if you already found another job. If you leave early, you sometimes get less unemployment benefits. You can lose 3 months of unemployment benefits If you choose to leave, you usually lose 3 months of unemployment benefits. It depends on what’s in your Aufhebungsvertrag. – How unemployment benefits work When you sign an Aufhebungsvertrag, you make a deal with your employer. You get more money, they get less problems. You can accept, refuse or negotiate this deal. Your employer can’t force you to sign an Aufhebungsvertrag. If you are not sure, get legal help.

title: Register as a job seeker
text: When you know that you will be unemployed, register as a job seeker at the Agentur für Arbeit. You must do this 3 months before your last day of work, or 3 days after you learn that you will be unemployed. If you wait too long, you get less unemployment benefits. How to register as a job seeker

title: Tell the Aus­län­der­be­hör­de
text: If you have a residence permit, always tell the Ausländerbehörde when you change or lose your job. Do not wait more than 2 weeks. [§ 82 Abs. 6 AufenthG] Permanent residents don’t need to do this. If you change employers, use the online form to tell the Ausländerbehörde. You get a PDF confirmation. If you lose your job, use my letter generator to write the message. Use the Ausländerbehörde ’s contact form to send it to the correct department. Attach your resignation letter or termination notice. Generate a letter to notify the Berlin immigration office of a job change. This tool requires JavaScript to work. The Ausländerbehörde will reply by email. It can take a few weeks. They might not reply at all. What happens to your residence permit

title: Register as unemployed
text: When you know your last day of work, register as unemployed at the Agentur für Arbeit. You must do this to get unemployment benefits. Do it in your last 3 months of work. How to register as unemployed

title: Tell your health insurance
text: When you are unemployed, you keep your health insurance. You keep the same coverage, but the price will change. What happens to your health insurance

title: Get a letter of reference
text: A letter of reference ( Arbeitszeugnis) is a proof of the work you did for your employer. It can help your job search. Your next employer can ask for it. Your employer is required to give you a letter of reference. [verdi.de, § 109 GewO] Ask for it in your resignation letter. Apprentices, working students, temporary workers and minijobbers can also demand a letter of reference. The letter must clearly explain the type of work you did, and for how long. Your employer must give you a paper version, not an electronic version. It must not have information about your health, your salary, your other jobs, your union membership, or your political affiliations. Your employer needs your explicit permission to mention why you quit or got fired. If you worked for more than 6 weeks, you can demand a qualified reference ( qualifiziertes Arbeitszeugnis). It includes an evaluation of your performance, and the reason you left the company.

title: Get an Ar­beits­be­schei­ni­gung
text: Before you get unemployment benefits, your employer must send your Arbeitsbescheinigung to the Agentur für Arbeit. [kanzlei-hallermann.de, § 312 SGB III, Agentur für Arbeit] Some employers take a long time to do this. How to get your Arbeitsbescheinigung

title: Get an Ur­laubs­be­schei­ni­gung
text: A vacation certificate ( Urlaubsbescheinigung) shows how many unused vacation days you have. It tells your next employer how many vacation days you should get this year. Your employer must give you an Urlaubsbescheinigung if you ask for it. [§ 6 Abs. 2 BUrlG, karrierebibel.de] Ask for it in your resignation letter. What happens to your vacation days

title: Get all other documents
text: Your employer will give you these documents after your last paycheck: [§ 41b EStG, prokontex.de, bewerbungen.de, Red Tape Translation (July 2023), Rotwang Law (July 2023)] Wage tax statement ( Lohnsteuerbescheinigung) Last pay slip ( Gehaltsabrechnung or Lohnabrechnung). You need these documents to apply for unemployment benefits, and to make a tax declaration.

title: Get coaching or training
text: If you get unemployment benefits, you can get free professional training, coaching and language lessons. The Agentur für Arbeit pays for it with a Bildungsgutschein or an AVGS voucher. Ask about it during your unemployment benefits appointment at the Agentur für Arbeit. Your case worker will decide if you can get free training.

title: Find a new job
text: How to find a job You can also start your own business and become self-employed. The Agentur für Arbeit can help you with free training and extra money ( Gründungszuschuss). You might need a different residence permit for this. How to start a business

title: Make a tax declaration
text: At the end of the year, make a tax declaration ( Steuererklärung). Your job search expenses are tax-deductible. – More information. If you get unemployment benefits, you must make a tax declaration. If you don’t get unemployment benefits, you should still make a tax declaration. If you were unemployed for a few months, you probably paid too much taxes. Make a tax declaration to get some money back. German tax software English-speaking tax advisors in Berlin

title: Ask for a pension refund
text: When you work in Germany, you pay 9.3% of your salary for pension insurance. If you leave Germany, you can get that money back. Calculate how much money you get back from a German pension payments refund. This tool requires JavaScript to work. How to get a pension payments refund

section: What happens to your residence permit
text: Always tell the Ausländerbehörde when you change or lose your job. In Berlin, they usually give you 6 to 12 months to find another job. [§ 7 Abs. 2 AufenthG, 7.2.2 VAB, David Kremers, anwalt.de, make-it-in-germany.com, Facebook, Charlott Posch of the Willkommenszentrum (June 2023), Beratungsservice of the Ausländerbehörde (June 2023), Red Tape Translation (July 2023), Carina Senf at Rotwang Law (July 2023), BAMF, Mirko Vorreuter (September 2025)] If you can’t find a job after 6 to 12 months, your residence permit expires, and you must leave Germany. To stay longer, you can get a different residence permit. You can apply for an opportunity card and get an extra 12 months to find a job. When you find a job, you might need the Ausländerbehörde ’s permission to start your new job. It depends on your residence permit.

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Blue Card
text: Check your Zusatzblatt. It tells you what you can do. In the first 12 months with a Blue Card, your new job must fulfil the Blue Card requirements. [§ 18g Abs. 4 AufenthG] You must tell the Ausländerbehörde that you have a new job. [VAB A.18g.4 (December 2024), § 82 Abs. 6 AufenthG] You can start working immediately. The Ausländerbehörde has 30 days to stop you. After 12 months of employment with a Blue Card, you can get any kind of job. There is no minimum salary requirement, but you can’t make less than € 13.90 per hour. You can start working immediately. [§ 18g Abs. 4 AufenthG] You should tell the Ausländerbehörde that you have a new job, but they can’t really stop you.

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Opportunity card
text: The opportunity card lets you work 20 hours per week for any employer. [§ 20a Abs. 2 AufenthG] To work full time, you must apply for a residence permit like a work visa or a Blue Card. You must wait for your residence permit before you work full time. It takes 3 to 6 months to get a residence permit. Residence permits to work in Germany

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Job seeker visa
text: Check your Zusatzblatt. It tells you if you can work with your job seeker visa. If not, you need another residence permit to start working. It takes 3 to 6 months to get a residence permit. Residence permits to work in Germany

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Family reunion visa
text: Your family reunion visa is not tied to your job. You can change jobs without permission from the Ausländerbehörde. If you lose your job, nothing happens to your residence permit. Your spouse and children’s family reunion visas are tied to your residence permit. If you can stay in Germany, they can stay in Germany. If you lose your residence permit, they usually lose their family reunion visa too. If your spouse has a family reunion visa and you lose your job, you can switch residence permits. You get a family reunion visa, and your spouse gets another residence permit. If you change jobs, you don’t need to update your spouse and children’s family reunion visas.

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Other residence permits
text: Check your Zusatzblatt. If it says “Beschäftigung erlaubt” or “Erwerbstätigkeit erlaubt”, you can start a new job immediately. You don’t need permission from the Ausländerbehörde. Usually, you need the Ausländerbehörde ’s permission to change jobs. You must apply for a new residence permit before you start working. It takes 3 to 6 months to get a residence permit. After 2 to 3 years in Germany, they might allow you to take any job, in any field, for any salary. [§ 9 Abs. 1 BeschV] Always tell the Ausländerbehörde about your new job, even if you don’t need their permission to change jobs.

section: What happens to your residence permit
title: Citizenship or permanent residence
text: If you are a EU citizen or a German permanent resident, nothing happens. You don’t need to a job to live in Germany. You don’t need permission to change jobs. Your permanent residence or citizenship application might be delayed until you find another job and finish your probation period. How to apply for permanent residence

section: What happens to your health insurance
text: When you lose your job, you stay insured. The coverage stays the same, but the price changes. Health insurance when unemployed

section: What happens to your pay and bonuses
text: You get paid until the end of your notice period, until your last day of work. Your employer must pay your full salary, even if you have no work to do. After your last day of work, you might get severance pay or unemployment benefits. This gives you financial support while you find another job. If your employer gives performance bonuses, you should get that bonus, even if you leave the company. Your bonus can be prorated. For example, if you should get a yearly performance bonus, but you leave in September, you should get 75% of the promised bonus. Bonuses are usually paid at the start of the next year. If you don’t get your bonus, talk to a lawyer.

section: What happens to your unused vacation days
text: Usually, your employer forces you use all your vacation days before the end of your notice period. You still get paid while on vacation. After you use all your vacation days, your employer might send you on garden leave. Vacation days when you change jobs During your notice period, you can still take sick days. You still get paid while on sick leave. Sick leave during your notice period

If you need help, hire an employment lawyer ( Anwalt für Arbeitsrecht). In Germany, it’s normal to hire a lawyer. It’s not an aggressive move. English-speaking lawyers in Berlin Other ways to get help
